verdicts.evidence: src/CLI/Rounds.jl:366-368 adds an unconditional `for f in findings; errs = validate(load_schema("finding"), f); ...` after hunt_bank!, and test/schemas.jl:96-98 tightens the liveness test — exactly as asked. But schema/finding.schema.json has additionalProperties:false and its properties list omits kind/verdict/observed/file/line/mechanism/witness_path/docs_url/witness_plan/second_location, while instruments/bug-hunt/schema.json's hunt_finding REQUIRES kind, verdict, observed, file, line, mechanism. hunt_bank! never strips these from `findings`, so every real bug-hunt bank now throws RoundError('unknown key') on its first finding. No test exercises Rounds.bank on a real bug-hunt lane file with a finding, so this regression is unexercised.
